visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-up shirt, stands in a brightly lit studio setting with a digital background of Taipei's night skyline, including Taipei 101. He gestures with his hands, moving his mouth and eyes expressively as he speaks toward the camera. A large text block is centered at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a graphic overlay of a scientific journal article excerpt, partially obscuring the man's face. The paper discusses recycled polyethylene and mRNA expression. (3) The man returns to full view, now holding a black pen in his right hand, pointing towards the camera to emphasize his points. The background remains constant with high-contrast city lights. (4) An image of multiple small, translucent zebrafish larvae is displayed in the center, showing their thin bodies and dark eyes on a white background. (5) The man is back on screen, using both hands to perform circular and grasping gestures. He appears concerned and focused. (6) A close-up image shows a person's hand in a blue nitrile glove holding a small glass vial filled with small, matte black plastic pellets against a neutral background. (7) The video returns to the man for the final segment. He continues his animated delivery, using hand gestures to punctuate his concluding remarks while the city skyline remains illuminated behind him.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 回收塑膠害你胖？ (2) [Subtitle]: 瘦不下來. (3) [Subtitle]: 一篇發表在有害物質期刊的. (4) [Subtitle]: 最新研究指出. (5) [Subtitle]: 回收塑膠可能正在對人體. (6) [Subtitle]: 強制增肥. (7) [Subtitle]: 由瑞典哥德堡大學領導的團隊. (8) [Subtitle]: 取得了來自台灣、印度跟奈及利亞的. (9) [Subtitle]: 黑色回收PE塑膠顆粒. (10) [Subtitle]: 把他們拿去泡茶. (11) [Subtitle]: 製成塑膠特調. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後拿去養斑馬魚寶寶. (13) [Subtitle]: 這些斑馬魚寶寶喝了塑膠特調之後. (14) [Subtitle]: 外表看起來好好的. (15) [Subtitle]: 沒死也沒畸形. (16) [Subtitle]: 可喜可賀. (17) [Subtitle]: 但科學家是重視內在的. (18) [Subtitle]: 於是把它們抓去驗基因. (19) [Subtitle]: 才發現這些魚體內與脂質生成. (20) [Subtitle]: 脂質代謝以及內分泌調控. (21) [Subtitle]: 相關的數個基因呢. (22) [Subtitle]: 他們的 mRNA 表現量有顯著的上升趨勢. (23) [Subtitle]: 這包含了與甲狀腺激素系統相關的基因. (24) [Subtitle]: 以及其他可能導致肥胖的分子路徑. (25) [Subtitle]: 欸簡單來說就是他們體內掌管. (26) [Subtitle]: 長肥肉跟內分泌的基因. (27) [Subtitle]: 整個大暴走啊. (28) [Subtitle]: 不過那是魚又不是我. (29) [Subtitle]: 欸這個就是有趣的地方了. (30) [Subtitle]: 論文指出斑馬魚之所以被選來當替身. (31) [Subtitle]: 就是因為他們導致肥胖的基因路徑. (32) [Subtitle]: 跟我們人類有很高的相似度. (33) [Subtitle]: 好吧可能沒那麼有趣了. (34) [Subtitle]: 更恐怖的是科學家分析那杯. (35) [Subtitle]: 強制增肥特調. (36) [Subtitle]: 在裡面找到了 84 種化學物質. (37) [Subtitle]: 除了塑膠添加劑還有不知道怎麼來的. (38) [Subtitle]: 殺蟲劑跟藥物. (39) [Subtitle]: 你可能會想說啊不是都有分級. (40) [Subtitle]: 有法規在管嗎. (41) [Subtitle]: 欸問題就在這裡. (42) [Subtitle]: 論文跟相關研究都指出. (43) [Subtitle]: 因為化學物質無法追蹤. (44) [Subtitle]: 法規不夠全面. (45) [Subtitle]: 導致這些有害物質早就流竄在. (46) [Subtitle]: 我們生活中的玩具甚至是食品包材裡了. (47) [Subtitle]: 所以這研究告訴我們. (48) [Subtitle]: 回收塑膠裡的環境荷爾蒙跟致胖劑. (49) [Subtitle]: 可能就是一種隱形殺手. (50) [Subtitle]: 他們不會讓你馬上怎樣. (51) [Subtitle]: 而是從基因層面悄悄地搞亂你的新陳代謝. (52) [Subtitle]: 塑膠回收就算做得再好. (53) [Subtitle]: 還是不用塑膠最好. (54) [Subtitle]: 畢竟循環經濟如果連毒素也一起循環. (55) [Subtitle]: 那也太經濟了.
